quick_facts.format: Classes, Labs, Jams & Rock CI · Performances & Talks

overview.manifesto_title: What does it mean to be grounded — as artists, as humans, as communities?

concept_blocks.label: 01 / Physical & Philosophical Practice
concept_blocks.text: Contact Improvisation as both a physical and philosophical practice — balancing between stability and flight, weight and suspension, presence and risk.

concept_blocks.label: 02 / Spaces for Dialogue
concept_blocks.text: Beyond physical practice, the festival opens spaces for dialogue, conversations around identity, body politics, and somatic awareness.

highlights: Daily CI classes, labs, and research sessions, jams with live music
Shared meals and informal gatherings in the heart of the Tirol mountains.
overview.conclusion: Motion Mode of Dialogue continues to be a space where art, movement, and social reflection meet — a place for connection, questioning, and discovery.

registration.intro_text: A full week of classes, performances, jams, and lectures offered at an affordable price.

passes.label: Half Pass
passes.title: Half of the festival regular participation:

helper.title: Special Participation: HELPER
helper.desc: Join our community in a unique way! This special participation lets you reduce costs by contributing your hands.

support.title: Support the Festival 🤍
support.text: Being an independent community festival, every gesture of support and solidarity enables scholarships and reduced ticket passes for dancers in need.

program.intro: The festival week follows an organic flow balancing rigorous physical morning labs, communal midday nourishment, contemplative afternoon dialogues, and evening jams accompanied by live musicians.

venue_food.venue_desc: Located on the slope of the Nordkette mountains just above the old town of Innsbruck, Künstlerhaus Büchsenhausen offers light-flooded studios, wooden sprung floors, and historic Alpine architecture.
venue_food.accommodation_info: Innsbruck offers a wide range of hostels, apartments, and camp sites. We also coordinate a community hosting network.
venue_food.food_desc: Maya Schwartz prepares fresh, nourishing, 100% vegetarian and vegan meals using organic produce sourced directly from Tirolean farmers.

team.name: Tamara Maksymenko
team.bio: Founder of Motion Mode of Dialogue in Tirol, choreographer, and somatic educator.
